evidence.quote: The following tuition fees apply for applicants from: non-EU countries 1,500 EUR
International degree-seeking students from non-EU countries pay the full semester contribution + tuition fees each semester.
Apply online via our application portal: https://campus.th-mannheim.de
E-mail your application documents for initial evaluation to Mrs Silke Förstermann (apply.eeb@elektrotechnik.th-mannheim.de).

name.fr: Formulaire d'information sur les frais de scolarité

evidence.quote: Required application documents School leaving certificates with grades and university transcripts of your current course of studies

English language proof (IELTS, TOEFL, OTE) CV (written in English and up-to-date) Letter of reference (written in English) from one of your teachers or professors, preferably in Maths or Physics Motivational letter (written in English, maximum one A4 page)
„Auskunftsformular“ on tuition fees (= information form for assessing whether the obligation to pay tuition fees for international students applies)

notes: Tuition: the non-EU figure of 1,500 EUR per semester is stated both on the DAAD page (non-EU applicants) and on the university's cost page for non-EU international degree-seeking students; the programme's own apply page requires an "Auskunftsformular" to assess the tuition-fee obligation, so exemptions may exist. Intake: the DAAD page gives the non-EU window 15 April - 15 May for the winter semester, and the programme's own page ("Next intake for winter semester 2026/27", portal opens 15 April 2026) fixes the year 2026; the page's general deadline 31 July and the recommended international date 15 May are not labelled for non-EU applicants specifically. Application channel: the pages describe application via the university's own campus portal (campus.th-mannheim.de), with a preliminary e-mail check by the department; no uni-assist route is mentioned. Documents are quoted from the programme's own apply page; translation is not mentioned for any document.

evidence.quote: English language skills B2 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: IELTS Academic: 6.5 TOEFL iBT (before 2026): 88
Proof of sufficient English language skills is one of the admission prerequisites (TOEFL minimum 88 (IBT); IELTS minimum 6.5; OTE minimum 130).

note.en: Check whether your school-leaving qualification gives direct access or whether you need a Studienkolleg / additional study semesters; criteria are not specified.
